name: Body Parts
source:
Have you ever wanted to create your own Visual Novel character? How about using some monster parts? Would you be able to play it as well as you would play a human? Find out the answers to this and more questions as you play Body Parts.

This is a game about a researcher that tries escaping the dungeon, possessing a monster she creates in her lab.  She is using the monster as a puppet,  which prevents her from getting hurt while looking for the way out.

[From [url=https://crimsonbloodgames.itch.io/body-parts]itch.io[/url]]
